label: Terminal Run
description: A terminal that types a single command character-by-character then streams output lines in one after another. Supports macOS-Terminal-inspired theme presets via data.theme: 'dark' (default), 'light', 'pro' (near-black, white text), 'ocean' (deep blue, white text), 'red-sands' (dark red-brown, amber text), 'homebrew' (black, green phosphor text), 'novel' (cream, dark brown text), 'silver-aerogel' (light glassy gray, near-black text), 'grass' (green felt, white text), 'clear-dark' (translucent dark glass, white text). Pick a theme that matches the scene's mood, e.g. {"command":"npm run deploy","theme":"homebrew"} for a retro hacker beat.
